args.reason: The PRDR adds one `--dry-run` flag that runs the existing merge-floor reads and suppresses only the final `gh pr merge` call. Every DoD item serves the first PRD goal (inspect current merge eligibility without risking a merge), and none adds capability beyond it: no history, storage or query. Reusing the existing floor reads keeps the floor logic the single source of truth, so the second goal is respected. The third DoD item (a test double asserting no merge call) directly guards the risk the goal names. Warranted and within scope.
